documentation_defect.resolution: Use manifest as source of truth; generate README count and validator output from manifest.

rules.rule: Preserve the exact native artboard dimensions and top-left pixel coordinate system.
Use a synchronized, stable-ID layer manifest as the source of truth for HTML/SVG layers and documentation counts.
Search for the exact typeface first; if unavailable or visually wrong, extract the visible letterforms from the reference and preserve them as source-derived glyph artwork/SVG where practical.
For elements already present in the source reference, attempt source extraction and masking before generating replacements.
basis: After the Noise nine source-derived assets

rules.rule: Assign each layer exactly one primary production method: SOURCE, GENERATE, CODE, SVG or TYPOGRAPHY.
Scope CSS rules and declare explicit per-layer coordinates and z-index; validate computed browser bounds after rendering.
Separate render, structural QA, visual review, numerical evaluation and fidelity acceptance statuses.
Run three review passes: structure, styling and fidelity/finishing, and retain defect records.
Run difference-map analysis and report mismatch ratio separately from colour threshold, plus MAE and SSIM with implementation settings.
Maintain asset provenance: source hash, source bounds or generation prompt, transform, output hash, dimensions, rights status and QA state.
Detect file format from bytes, not filename extension.
basis: After the Noise supplied filename .png, detected JPEG

rules.rule: Keep offline output self-contained by embedding or packaging all required image and font assets locally when requested.
Inspect alpha-mask edges, halos, gaps and feathering at native artboard size.
basis: After the Noise extracted architecture and paper fragments

rules.rule: Use regional QA weights for critical typography, logos and key objects; do not rely on one global score.
basis: inference from documented global metrics and unresolved typography

rules.rule: Correct the smallest defective layer group, then rerun affected checks and full-frame QA.

change_status.note: This archive documents learnings and fixes first. Integration is a separate next step requiring explicit review.
